egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-15↗ prob:eigenvalues ↗ prob:harmonic-functions

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a compact Riemannian $n$-manifold (without boundary) and $u \in C^\infty (M)$ is an eigenfunction of $M$, meaning that $-\Delta u = \lambda u$ for some constant $\lambda $ (see Prob. 2-24). Prove that \[ \lambda \int _M |\operatorname {grad} u|^2 \, dV_g \le n \int _M | abla ^2 u|^2 \, dV_g. \] [Hint: Consider the 2-tensor field $ abla ^2 u - rac{1}{n}(\Delta u)g$, and use one of Green's identities (Prob. 2-23).] (Used on p. 223.) \end{exercise}
